extDescription: Chat with Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible AI model right from the browser
corsDescription: Allow additional web origins so this extension can reach Ollama.
noEndpointsDescription: Add an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible endpoint to get started.
deleteEndpointDescription: This will remove "$1" and all its conversations.
connectFailedOllama: Unable to connect. Check that Ollama is running at $1.
connectFailedOpenai: Unable to connect. Check the URL and API key.
noModelsOllama: No models found. Pull a model with $1.
noModelsOpenai: No chat models found on this server.
ollamaDescription: Connect to an Ollama server. Default port is 11434.
ollamaContextHint: Number of tokens for the context window (num_ctx).
openaiDescription: Connect to OpenAI or any server with an OpenAI-compatible API, such as OpenRouter, LM Studio, llama.cpp or vLLM.
openaiUrlHint: API base URL, usually ending in /v1.
apiKeyHint: Sent as a Bearer token. Local servers usually need none.
openaiContextHint: Model context window in tokens, for the usage meter and page trimming. Defaults to what the server reports, or $1.
systemPromptHint: Prepended as a system message to every conversation.
urlInvalid: Enter a valid URL (http:// or https://)
contextSizeInvalid: Context size must be a number ≥ 256
commandPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Explain the following in simple terms.
deleteCommandDescription: This will permanently delete the "$1" command.
historyLimitDescription: Only the last $1 conversations are kept. Older chats are automatically removed.
noConversationsDescription: Start a new chat to see it here.
noEndpointConnectedDescription: Add an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible endpoint to start chatting.
usageReported: Actual token usage reported by the server for the last request.
usageNotReported: The server did not report token usage for this chat.
usageEmpty: Send a message to see actual token usage.
contextExceeded: Context window exceeded, older messages may be dropped.
includePageDescription: Extracts the visible text from the current page and sends it as additional data with your message.
pageTruncated: Page content exceeds remaining context and will be automatically truncated to fit.
noPageText: No extractable text found on this page.
notJson: Unexpected response from server (not JSON). Check the URL.
noResponseBody: No response body - streaming not supported
